title: Cosmic Crystal Oracle
description: A glowing crystal ball rests on an ornate metallic pedestal atop a circuit-patterned floor. Inside the sphere, a silhouetted female figure stands at the center emitting vibrant neon energy beams in multiple colors while surrounded by abstract cosmic shapes against a swirling purple and black nebula background.
prompt: A glowing transparent crystal ball on a heavy metallic steampunk base sits on a floor covered in glowing orange circuit patterns. Inside the sphere a black female silhouette stands with arms raised as multicolored neon beams in green, yellow, blue and pink radiate outward from her body. Abstract cosmic shapes and dots float within the orb. Dramatic swirling purple and black nebula fills the background with luminous highlights, surreal mystical atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
